title: hyv-evaluate-local
description: Run the optional deterministic local writing evaluation composite without model calls.
evidence_requirements: Report that the authorship component is a local train-only proxy, not an authorship verdict.
Do not allow paragraph IDs in both train and test sets.
stop_conditions: Stop when either fixture has fewer than two unique paragraph IDs or the JSON schema is invalid.

tool_free_mode.behavior: Provide the exact command and state that the report is NOT_RUN; never invent scores.
